$comment: Shared design decisions for the Muraka dashboard, Android app and iOS app. Colour is derived from the phenomenon: living coral tissue reads teal, bleached coral reads bone-white (because that is literally its colour), and rust is reserved for destructive actions so it never competes with data. Mirror of web/src/assets/theme.css — change both together.

condition.$comment: The scale runs from living tissue to bare skeleton. Do not substitute a red/green scale.

signal.$comment: rust is for destructive actions and failures only; verified marks expert-reviewed provenance.

severityRamp.$comment: Stops for the bleached-extent scale, 0 to 1. Interpolate in sRGB.

typography.$comment: No webfonts anywhere (the project forbids external service dependencies), so personality comes from the pairing. Every measured quantity — coordinate, depth, severity, count — is set in mono like an instrument readout. Small uppercase mono labels act as section markers.

readout.$comment: Use tabular figures so columns of numbers align.

eyebrow.$comment: Section markers: mono, uppercase, letterspaced. Prefer carrying a value — 'QUEUE / 148 PENDING' rather than 'QUEUE'.

motion.$comment: Two deliberate moments only: the patch lattice sweeping in as if inference were scanning the image, and queue items leaving. Respect the platform reduce-motion setting.

patchLattice.$comment: The signature element, shared by all three clients. Cells cover the CENTRE SQUARE of the photo, matching how the server tiles it.

provenance.$comment: NFR13: a model label must never be mistaken for an expert verdict, and the difference must survive greyscale and colour blindness. Encode it in shape, not colour.
